bugs.text: The file is truncated at line 466 (mid-string inside the EXPLOSION array, lines 118-466, which degenerates into ~345 identical all-'1' frames). There is no </script>, the script is a SyntaxError (node --check: 'Invalid or unexpected token' at file line 466), so no JavaScript runs. The game never shows anything but an empty 300x150 black canvas.
Almost the whole game is missing: no input handling, game state, enemies, player, update logic, rendering, HUD or game loop was ever written; output degenerated into repeating explosion-frame rows.

The play-test reported loads_clean=true with no errors even though the inline script cannot parse; the harness evidently did not capture the SyntaxError, but canvas/title/start/move checks are all false and all screenshots are blank.

summary: Submission A is not a game. The model wrote a reasonable preamble (integer-scaled 224x288 canvas setup, a palette, catmull-rom helper, a Web Audio sfx() table covering every required sound, and small 2-frame pixel sprites for the fighter, captured fighter, Boss in green/blue, Goei, Zako and the six badge denominations), then fell into a repetition loop while writing the EXPLOSION frame data and emitted ~345 identical 11x11 all-'1' frames until output was cut off mid-string at line 466. There is no closing </script>, so the script is a syntax error and none of it runs; there is also no state, input, update, render or loop code at all. Every screenshot shows only the default 300x150 empty canvas. Nothing of Galaga's gameplay exists, so every rubric item scores 0.
